episodes.title: Disk full on the database volume

note: Thresholds derived from a reference implementation, not guessed. Ranking clusters by rarity scores 0.000 here, and so does a generic severity keyword search: the fixture contains a long tail of rare but harmless events. What works is temporal concentration, how much of a cluster falls inside its busiest few minutes. Grouping F1 was LOWERED from 0.80 because the reference reaches only 0.79.
